body: Chief: the split is ACCEPTED as the honest form — common JVM/JS/Native suite (real WOG inference → canonical/no-text bytes → exact contextual round-trip) plus a JVM-only resource suite pinning the committed 25,598-byte hsmm-v1 golden (checksum cdc8047d…44b3, decode == original). Do NOT claim cross-platform floating-bit identity; state in ADR 0001 (next to hsmm/v1) and the codec README that the committed golden is the JVM/JS canonical encoding, that Native differs in low-order libm bits, and that the platform-independent claim is decode-equivalence (validated + matched succeed and the decoded result equals the original on every platform). No build-time resource generator. One addition: the JVM resource suite must also assert that the committed JSON contains no story text (canary grep over the WOG surface strings) — the golden is a wire artifact, not a transcript.
